prompt: On an older cached Safari/iPad build, startup shows exactly `Can't find variable: Notification`. Nothing in the report confirms whether a run is active. Should we auto-refresh, match all ReferenceErrors, or offer a recovery action? Tell me what staff should see.
assertions: The response routes this exact Safari Notification reference error to .agents/memory/pwa-update-prompts.md or explicitly identifies the PWA update policy as the source.

The response rejects automatic reload and broad ReferenceError matching.
